```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning= FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

```{r packages}
library(metafor)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r create dataset}
meta_data <- data.frame(
  study = c(
    "Study 1 - Generation",
    "Study 2 - Generation",
    "Study 3 - Generation",
    "Study 1 - Explanation",
    "Study 4 - Explanation",
    "Study 5 - Explanation"
  ),
  
  intervention = c(
    "Generation",
    "Generation",
    "Generation",
    "Explanation",
    "Explanation",
    "Explanation"
  ),
  
  d = c(
    0.2762668,   # Study 1 Generation
    0.2037341,   # Study 2 Generation
    0.0670939,   # Study 3 Generation
    
    0.3862670,   # Study 1 Explanation
    0.2076115,   # Study 4 Explanation
    0.0599345    # Study 5 Explanation
  ),
  
  n_control = c(
    105,
    166,
    258,
    105,
    146,
    263
  ),
  
  n_exp = c(
    105,
    165,
    257,
    114,
    137,
    252
  )
)

meta_data
```
```{r convert to hedge and sampling variance}
meta_data <- meta_data %>%
  mutate(
    df = n_control + n_exp - 2,
    
    # small-sample correction
    J = 1 - (3 / (4 * df - 1)),
    
    # Hedges' g
    g = J * d,
    
    # sampling variance of Cohen's d
    var_d = (n_control + n_exp) / (n_control * n_exp) +
      (d^2 / (2 * df)),
    
    # sampling variance of Hedges' g
    var_g = J^2 * var_d,
    
    se_g = sqrt(var_g)
  )

meta_data
```

```{r meta generation}
meta_generation <- rma(
  yi = g,
  vi = var_g,
  data = meta_data %>% filter(intervention == "Generation"),
  method = "REML"
)

meta_generation


forest(
  meta_generation,
  slab = meta_data$study[meta_data$intervention == "Generation"],
  xlab = "Hedges' g",
  refline = 0
)
```
```{r meta explanation}

meta_explanation <- rma(
  yi = g,
  vi = var_g,
  data = meta_data %>% filter(intervention == "Explanation"),
  method = "REML"
)

meta_explanation

forest(
  meta_explanation,
  slab = meta_data$study[meta_data$intervention == "Explanation"],
  xlab = "Hedges' g",
  refline = 0
)

writexl::write_xlsx(meta_data, "metanalysis_data.xlsx")

```

```{r meta moderator}

meta_moderator <- rma(
  yi = g,
  vi = var_g,
  mods = ~ intervention,
  data = meta_data,
  method = "REML"
)

meta_moderator

```

```{r}
meta_generation_fixed <- rma(
  yi = g,
  vi = var_g,
  data = meta_data %>% filter(intervention == "Generation"),
  method = "FE"
)

meta_explanation_fixed <- rma(
  yi = g,
  vi = var_g,
  data = meta_data %>% filter(intervention == "Explanation"),
  method = "FE"
)

meta_generation_fixed
meta_explanation_fixed
```
